items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Thad has a leading band to me, you know. ... Thad and eh, but bad and Mel's reed section, very beautiful.

ctx.x: Well, Clifford, now. You take a cat like Clifford. He did something recently. I don't think it's released yet. He and Dizzy Reese, Richard Davis, Mahal, Richard Abrams -- he's got a tuba in there. Might be Bob

Stewart or Howard Johnson and the old boy sounds so beautiful. Beautiful. I heard the taping of it. I'm just waiting on it. But like you said, where is the music going? Who knows? Somebody's got to step out and lead. There's always been a leader, somebody step out in front. Thad has a leading band to me, you know.
